protocol.scope: exploratory after original ONE_END CKA observations, before any transformed hidden-state measurements
protocol.holdout: all three seeds and all four operators of one complete source group
baseline: input operator and initialization fixed effects
protocol.addition: exact source-answer categorical-kernel CKA under the same operator
protocol.interpretation: conditional prediction of a geometric metric, not proof of transfer or a uniquely learned algebra
protocol.selection: report all four landmarks and both length treatments; no select-best landmark primary claim
